description: January birthdays: zodiac signs and decans for every day of January, cusp dates, the month's numerology and its Chinese zodiac boundary.
answer: In Western astrology, January birthdays fall under Capricorn and Aquarius. In most years January birthdays from the 1st to the 20th are Capricorn, and from the 21st they are Aquarius. January 19, January 20 and January 21 are cusp dates. In numerology January is month 1.

sections.heading: Zodiac signs and decans in January
paragraphs: January opens in Capricorn's second decan, the stretch with Venus as sub-ruler, so the first ten days carry ambition along with a taste for quality. Around January 11 the third decan begins, and Mercury sharpens the Goat's strategic mind. Then, around January 20, the Sun crosses into Aquarius and the tone changes noticeably: from earth to air, from cardinal to fixed, from building within the structure to questioning it. The last days of the month sit in Aquarius' first decan, where Uranus is doubled and independence comes to the fore, and from about January 30 Mercury begins to colour the second decan. A January birthday therefore sits somewhere on a journey from patience to invention, and people born near the switch often recognise something of both in themselves.

In most years January birthdays from the 1st to the 20th are Capricorn, and from the 21st they are Aquarius. The cusp dates, where the sign can differ by year or time zone, are January 19, 20 and 21; each has its own page explaining both possibilities. Decan by decan, the month opens in the second decan of Capricorn, linked with Venus, from the 11th the third decan of Capricorn, linked with Mercury, from the 21st the first decan of Aquarius, linked with Uranus and from the 30th the second decan of Aquarius, linked with Mercury.

sections.heading: January birthdays in numerology and the Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: In numerology, January is month 1, which links it with initiative and the urge to begin. Combined with the day and year of birth, it feeds into the Life Path calculation and adds a self-starting note to the month's birthdays. The Chinese zodiac needs more care. Lunar New Year falls between January 21 and February 20, so anyone born in January before that year's new year belongs to the previous year's animal, not the one printed on the calendar. In practice, every birthday from January 1 to 20 falls in the previous Chinese year, and later January dates depend on the exact year. Four Pillars practitioners also place most of January in the Ox month, which begins around January 5 or 6 and is traditionally associated with steady, patient effort.

Every page for a January date lists the Life Path for several birth years, because the year changes the total even when the day stays the same. Those pages also show how many years since 1924 had already reached Lunar New Year by that date.

sections.heading: Famous January birthdays
paragraphs: Each January page lists the best-known people born on that date, drawn from Wikidata and ranked by how many Wikipedia language editions have an article about them. A sample across the month: J. D. Salinger (January 1), Gao Xingjian (January 4), Millard Fillmore (January 7), Donald Knuth (January 10), Wilhelm Wien (January 13), Susan Sontag (January 16), Edgar Allan Poe (January 19), Lord Byron (January 22), Volodymyr Zelenskyy (January 25), Nicolas Sarkozy (January 28) and Franz Schubert (January 31). Sharing a birthday with someone well known says nothing about a life's direction, but it is a pleasant way into the date's sign, decan and numbers, which each page then explains in turn. The lists favour people with a precisely recorded birth date in the modern Gregorian calendar, so some much-celebrated figures from earlier centuries are missing.

faq.question: What zodiac signs are January birthdays?
faq.answer: In most years January birthdays from the 1st to the 20th are Capricorn, and from the 21st they are Aquarius. The cusp dates, where the sign can differ by year or time zone, are January 19, 20 and 21; each has its own page explaining both possibilities.

faq.question: What is the numerology number of January?
faq.answer: January is month 1. The month is one of three parts of the Life Path calculation, with the day and the year.

faq.question: Which Chinese zodiac animal is someone born in January?
faq.answer: Births from January 1 to 20 always take the previous year's animal, because Lunar New Year is never earlier than January 21. From January 21 it depends on that year's Lunar New Year date.
